summary: A free school handwriting font for teaching literacy, shown on the same HT Fonts image-feed template as Weg but in a pastel classroom palette: a bilingual design brief, the six 'fonts' of the family (Regular, super-connected, Montessori guideline overlays) on fruit-mascot samples, letter anatomy and contextual-connection diagrams, worksheet exercises per language and glyph patterns. All specimens are raster images (only Alegreya Sans is live), so the page reads as a teacher's handbook rather than a tool.
